description: Open CASCADE's own STEP of primitive/box converted to B-splines (occt_step.py --nurbs), every face a NURBS surface, cut by the box [19,14,4]–[21,16,6] inside it: the boolean classifies the tool's faces against the part by a ray, which has no closed form against a NURBS face, and the fault comes back as OpError::Internal(Classify) instead of the typed refusal. Shrunk from the battery of real/nist-ftc-07 and real/nist-ftc-10, whose every cut and drill meets it (ADR-0026 §5: a boolean on a NURBS face is the NURBS cycle's)
